freeze_semantics: Operational supplement added before any occurrence count, map, sampling-availability outcome, environmental value, invariant metric, or knockout result was opened. Numeric sampling thresholds are unchanged.

identity_normalization.event_day: use_valid_YYYY-MM-DD_prefix_only; otherwise identity date is unavailable
identity_normalization.coordinate_key: WGS84 latitude and longitude formatted independently to exactly 5 decimal places
identity_normalization.coordinate_key_note: The key is only an identity witness when combined with dataset+day or recorder+day; it is not a spatial thinning rule.

same_record_collision.graph_rule: build an undirected graph connecting records that share any available identity witness; take connected-component closure across witness types
same_record_collision.cross_partner_action: exclude every record in every connected component containing both x and y
same_record_collision.single_partner_component_action: retain; this rule is specifically a cross-partner contamination guard

independent_record_semantics: retained record means independent of the opposite partner under the declared collision graph; it does not claim IID sampling and does not add post hoc within-partner thinning

sampling_cell.projection_boundary: the pure preprocessing module accepts already-projected EPSG:6933 coordinates and performs no network or CRS lookup
